proof_summary: Legendre’s formula reduces divisibility to prime-adic inequalities, whose baseline follows termwise from \(\lfloor3K/d\rfloor+\lfloor3L/d\rfloor\ge\lfloor K/d\rfloor+\lfloor L/d\rfloor+2\lfloor(K+L)/d\rfloor\) with \(K=4n+2\) and \(L=2n+3\). The extra \(2^2\) margin comes from analyzing the first two binary powers (by \(n\bmod4\)), while the extra \(3^3\) margin follows from the ternary digit-sum form of Legendre’s formula and the identities induced by multiplication by \(3\) and \(6n+5=2+3(2n+1)\).
